dataset_name: Model 6 Clinical Summary Generator Dataset - Expanded Synthetic v1
description: Synthetic, schema-consistent conversation-to-structured-clinical-state dataset for training a medical conversation summary generator. Expanded to 1000 examples across 10 chief-complaint categories, 100 distinct clinical-summary scenarios, and 10 paraphrased conversation realizations per scenario. This is a synthetic research dataset and is not clinical validation data.
